# Eight Determinations — The Complete Traversal

## #0 — One relation, threshold to return

The eight determinations traverse the inner nature of `0/1`: the parent relation, the sixfold's qualitative body, and the return through which its achieved expression recognises its ground. The count is **(4+2)+2**. The two thresholds bracket the six positions; they do not add two interior positions to QL.

The [core-theorems spine](episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md), §II(c), sources this distinction. [A18](../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) derives the whole traversal and its consequences. This index gathers the root pages so that a reader can follow their differences without losing their sequence:

$$
-/-\;\longrightarrow\;0/1\;\longrightarrow\;?/!\;\longrightarrow\;-/+\;\longrightarrow\;X/x\;\longrightarrow\;AM/IS\;\longrightarrow\;\infty/dx\;\longrightarrow\;1/0.
$$

## #1 — The parent opens an accountable circumstance

[The slash, / = −/−](the-slash.md), grounds relation before named terms. Its two unassigned marks become distinguishable through one activity. [0/1](0-1.md) extends that relation as conscious circumstance: awareness and appearing phenomenon, singular One and polyvalent All, remain distinguishable within one event.

[?/!](question-assertion.md) extends the circumstance into answerability. A question takes a provisional mark; an assertion remains exposed to whether it runs true. The mark can now acquire force because it commits the field in a determinate direction.

## #2 — The mark becomes force, pattern, and person

[−/+](minus-plus.md) extends marking as reserve and issue. The poles sustain a pulse; contraction makes a distinction available and extension gives it consequences. [X/x](X-x.md) extends force into recognisable recurrence. Determining capacity becomes legible in its particular face, while the instance can recur, compound, and give subsequent acts something to inherit.

[AM/IS](AM-IS.md) extends that recurrence into personed context. First-person presence and third-person sayability meet through second-person relation. The pattern can be described; the person whose life it describes can answer. Context holds the relation within the world in which its truth matters.

## #3 — The horizon returns the achieved field

[∞/dx](infinity-dx.md) extends personed knowing into exact local difference and an unbounded horizon. Precision is possible without possession of the whole condition from which the local determination was taken. The calculus development makes one instance exact: differentiation loses an additive constant, and integration restores a family whose particular member requires a further condition.

[1/0](1-0.md) returns the achieved field towards its ground. The mark meets the condition it presupposes through recognition. Its determinations remain real; their return does not turn the ground into one further object. This is the consequent essence and the `5→0` return vector named by the central-plan amendment, through which 5 remains implicated in 1.

## #4 — The sequence folds across itself

The six interior determinations have both forward harmonics and complementary folds:

| Reading | Paired positions | Relation carried |
|---|---|---|
| Being | 0/1 with ?/! | Conscious circumstance becomes answerable. |
| Becoming | −/+ with X/x | Force becomes recognisable recurrence. |
| Knowing/unKnowing | AM/IS with ∞/dx | Personed knowledge retains its horizon. |
| Essence | #0 + #5 | Opening circumstance and differential depth share one openness. |
| Constitution | #1 + #4 | Definition answers within a personed world. |
| Text–Texture | #2 + #3 | Felt force and readable pattern keep their common movement. |

Four root heads gather further readings of the spine. [Mono–Poly](mono-poly.md) grounds the mutual implication of one and many. [Complexio oppositorum](complexio-oppositorum.md) gathers opposed directions and transformation under `#`. [Self-identity](self-identity.md) derives the self-relation that unfolds `0/1` into `4+2`. [Subject-logics](subject-logics.md) extends the crossed-zero sequence through the progressive recognition of its mediating instrument. These four heads and the eight determinations comprise the **twelvefold root layer**; this index adds no thirteenth determination.

The [matheme register](matheme/README.md) extends their exact operations in its locked structure. Its two chains retain their vantages: definition/quilt carry the short chain; process/music carry the full chain. Its inverse-phase primes and Night-pass primes have different offices. A local root relation can enter these developments without making their distinct positional readings interchangeable.

## #5→0 — Return to the passage that opened the field

This traversal returns-to [§3 · #0, Eight Determinations](../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/25-s3-p0-eight-determinations.md), where the essay takes up the full qualitative sequence. [A18](../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) returns its consequences to the wider argument, including recognition, counterfeit source relations, and the capacity of a determination to revise its field.

The index's routes let one relation be followed from either threshold, through its successive joints, or across its folds. Each root retains a distinct operation. Returning to the beginning carries what those differences have made available.
